svg.title: Marrakesh and ABC accessible-book access checks
svg.desc: Three separate checks: legal exchange route, authorized-entity participation and beneficiary access. Treaty participation alone does not confirm a particular book's availability.

g.text: Treaty participation and a completed book handoff are different facts.
Check treaty implementation and the applicable authorization route.
Confirm the organization, agreement, metadata and file arrangements.
Confirm the eligible entity's route for its own beneficiaries.
Rex preparation guidance · No claim of tested delivery or individual legal clearance.
